watches.name: Stanley
watches.description: NEW ARRIVAL - Introducing the all new Stanley, a refined automatic timepiece that combines natural beauty with mechanical precision. Featuring an elegant open heart dial, hour, minute, and second markers, and a circular face, the Stanley is crafted from 100% recycled or reclaimed wood. A stainless steel crown and scratch resistant sapphire crystal provide lasting durability and clarity. Inside, the upgraded Miyota automatic movement is built with 22 jewels and is known for its high quality and reliability. It winds automatically with the wearer's natural motion, eliminating the need for a battery, and offers a power reserve of 40 hours when fully wound. Each Stanley is adjustable in size and one of a kind, with natural variations in wood grain and tone. Proudly made in Canada and part of 1% for the Planet, this watch reflects a commitment to both timeless design and environmental responsibility. NOTE: Due to the unique nature of wood, each watch is one-of-a-kind and may vary slightly from the images on our website.

watches.name: Hampton Custom
watches.description: The watch that started most people's Tense collection. Now made exactly the way you want it.
